2608.23484.title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation
2608.23484.paper_summary: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.
2608.23484.paper_summary_zh: 我們呈現 Team Semiintelligencn 在 ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge 的解決方案，通過一個多模態和個性化的對話推薦系統來解決對話音樂推薦問題。<lb/>我們提交的系統採用三階段管道：(1) 多模態檢索，在七個密集嵌入空間中構建衰減加權的質心——音軌和用戶級 CF-BPR、Qwen3（元數據、歌詞、屬性）、CLAP 音頻和 SigLIP 視覺——輔以 BM25 詞彙檢索和藝術家子串匹配信號，所有信號通過加權的互惠排名融合（RRF）融合，並優化信號權重；(2) 輕量級重排序（歷史過濾、流行度平滑和目錄多樣性懲罰）；以及 (3) 使用 GPT-4o-mini 生成多樣化的回應。<lb/>除了這個提交的配置外，我們報告了開發期間的實驗，涉及額外的組件——受限的 LLM 引導藝術家注入、專輯延續信號、XGBoost LambdaMART 和更高效的 GPT-4.1 回應提示——由於成本和複雜性限制，這些組件未在 Blind B 中部署。<lb/>我們通過差異進化在 500 次會話的開發拆分上優化 RRF 權重，將 MRR 提高了 +19.5%。<lb/>在 Blind A 中，我們觀察到在 54 次會話中，無限制的 LLM 引導注入導致災難性的 nDCG 回歸（-18.9%），而在僅 9 次會話中進行保守注入則產生了最佳的 Blind A nDCG——這一發現我們提出作為需要進一步驗證的 Blind A 觀察。<lb/>提交的系統在 Blind B 中達到了 0.3213 的綜合得分。
